name: ai-project-idea-generator-and-mentor
description: AI-powered platform that helps final-year students generate, compare, architect, and refine capstone project ideas with Groq and MongoDB Atlas.

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
